about: Date allocation for 'Asia 2027 · Full draft' (coordinator output; SCHEMA.md §4). One entry per trip date 2027-10-02 … 2027-11-07. `sleep` = where you sleep AFTER that day (Yonder trip_days.night_node). Titles are suggestions except owner days (kept as imported). Builders must keep dates, sleeps and the flight markers; they choose the actual hotels, items and the focus of each free day.

trip.name: Asia 2027 · Full draft
trip.dayNumbering: Trip day 1 = Sat 2027-10-02 (JFK departure). The owner's Itinerary 'Day N' = trip day N+1 (Itinerary Day 1 = Sun 2027-10-03).

japan.note: Oct 2 = flight marker only; Oct 3–8 are owner days (additions only); Oct 14 = 'before' half.

korea.note: Oct 14 = 'after' half (from KE726); Oct 20 = 'before' half (until VN423).

vietnam.note: Oct 20 = 'after' half (from VN423); Nov 2 = 'before' half (until BR398).

taiwan.note: Nov 2 = 'after' half (from BR398); Nov 6 ends with the TK25 marker; Nov 7 = the TK25 block's IST layover + EWR arrival only (write the day with just the marker).

days.title: Fly JFK → Tokyo
notes: Leave home Fri Oct 1 evening: the flight is at 02:00 on Sat Oct 2 (be at JFK T7 ~23:30 Fri). The day holds only the flight block; its start becomes 00:00.

days.title: Tokyo · Haneda + Shibuya (arrival)
notes: Owner's Itinerary Day 1 — keep items exactly. The NH159 arrival item goes first (before 'Breakfast').

Hotel: check-in ~15:00; bags forwarded from Haneda by takkyubin (owner's note). Shinjuku suits Oct 7 (Fuji Excursion leaves Shinjuku 08:30); Day 1 dinner says 'Shibuya / near hotel', so Shibuya also works.

days.title: Tokyo · Asakusa / Ginza
notes: Owner's Itinerary Day 2 (Mon: Kappabashi open; Bar Centifolia closed Wed only).

days.title: Tokyo · Nakano + Shinjuku
notes: Owner's Itinerary Day 3 (Tue: Bar Benfiddich open; closed Sun).

days.title: Tokyo · Harajuku / Omotesando
notes: Owner's Itinerary Day 4 (Wed Oct 6: Imabari Towel closes 2nd Tue only — open).
Optional: forward big bags tonight by takkyubin straight to the Nagoya hotel (owner's Day 5 note) and carry an overnight bag to the ryokan.

days.title: Mt. Fuji · Shinjuku → Kawaguchiko

sleep.note: Existing node + stay from the sheet import (ryokan check-in item).

moves.label: Fuji Excursion 1 · Shinjuku 08:30 → Kawaguchiko 10:22
moves.bookingWindow: JR East: 1 month before at 10:00 JST (2027-09-07 10:00 JST)

notes: Owner's Itinerary Day 5 — the Fuji Excursion leg already exists (sheet import); the draft may add fixed times to it only if the importer supports editing that leg.

days.title: Mt. Fuji → Nagoya

moves.label: Fujikyu bus Kawaguchiko → Shiraito Falls (~1h10, ~3/day)
Bus Shiraito → Shin-Fuji Sta., Kodama Shin-Fuji → Nagoya (~2.5–3 h)

notes: Owner's Itinerary Day 6 — keep items exactly; only add the Nagoya hotel stay.
Send bags Nagoya → Kyoto hotel by takkyubin tonight (arrives Oct 9) so Ghibli Park day is hands-free.

days.title: Nagoya · Ghibli Park → Kyoto

moves.label: Nagoya Sta. → Ghibli Park: Higashiyama Line to Fujigaoka + Linimo to Ai·Chikyuhaku-kinen-koen (~50 min)
Tokaido Shinkansen Nozomi Nagoya → Kyoto (~35 min), e.g. ~18:40 → 19:15

notes: Ghibli Park (Must/Must): Sat Oct 9 — open 09:00–17:00 on weekends, closed Tuesdays; tickets are date + time specific and sell out: sale opens 14:00 JST on the 10th of the month two months before (→ 2027-08-10 14:00 JST).
Nagoya counts 1 day (Oct 8 evening + Oct 9).

days.title: Kyoto · Fushimi Inari + Higashiyama
notes: Suggested focus only — the Japan builder decides. Fushimi Inari (Must) is best ~06:00–07:00.
3-day weekend in Japan (Sat Oct 9 – Mon Oct 11 Sports Day): expect crowds; start early.

days.title: Kyoto · Arashiyama + Kinugasa
notes: Mon Oct 11 = Sports Day (national holiday): museums normally closed Mon are open today and close Tue Oct 12 instead.
Arashiyama Bamboo Grove (Must) + Otagi Nenbutsu-ji (Really want) early morning.
Consider 1 night at a Kyoto ryokan with private onsen (Action Timeline row 17).

days.title: Kyoto → Uji → Nara → Osaka

moves.label: JR Nara Line Kyoto → Uji (~20 min)
JR Nara Line Uji → Nara (~30–40 min)
Kintetsu Nara → Osaka-Namba (rapid express ~40 min)

notes: Uji ~1–1.5 h (matcha on Byodoin Omotesando: Nakamura Tokichi / Itoh Kyuemon; shopping list 'Matcha / tea'), Nara ~3.5 h (Nara Park, Todai-ji).
Tue after a Monday holiday: some museums closed (e.g. Nara National Museum); Todai-ji and Byodoin open daily.
Luggage: send Kyoto → Osaka hotel by takkyubin on Oct 11 (next-day) or use a same-day hands-free service at Kyoto Station.

days.title: Osaka
notes: Builder decides between Universal Studios (Want, full day, Express Pass, date-specific → fixedDate) and a city day (Dotonbori Must, Osaka Castle, Harukas 300, Shinsaibashi).
Shopping list: Nishikawa custom pillow fitting at Daimaru Shinsaibashi (~1 h, ~¥30k, reserve) — tax refund with passport.

days.title: Osaka → Seoul

sleep.area: Seoul Station / Myeongdong (AREX + KTX both at Seoul Station)

moves.label: Nankai rapi:t Namba → KIX (~38 min, reserved); leave by ~15:00
AREX Express ICN T2 → Seoul Station (~43 min)

notes: Half 'before' (Japan builder): Osaka morning until ~15:00 — e.g. Katsuoji (Minoh, Must) or Dotonbori/Kuromon; then the KE726 marker.
At KIX: customs tax-refund check for Japan purchases BEFORE security (refund-type system since 2026-11-01) — allow 3 h.
Half 'after' (Korea builder): KE726 marker, AREX, hotel check-in, late snack. Stay is set by the Korea half.

days.title: Seoul
notes: Fri: palaces open (Gyeongbokgung closed Tue, Changdeokgung closed Mon). Seongsu, Hannam, Itaewon, Starfield Library (COEX).

days.title: Seoul
notes: Sat: busy in Seongsu/Hongdae; book any popular restaurants.

days.title: Seoul → Busan (KTX)

moves.label: KTX Seoul → Busan (~2h40), e.g. ~08:30 → ~11:10
moves.bookingWindow: KTX: 2 months before (from Oct 2026; time of day assumed 07:00 KST — verify)

notes: Sun: Busan afternoon, e.g. Gamcheon Culture Village + Jagalchi market.

days.title: Busan
notes: Haedong Yonggungsa (beautiful at sunrise), Haeundae Blueline Park Sky Capsule (book), Dongbaekseom, Gwangalli at night.

days.title: Busan
notes: Oryukdo Skywalk, Seokbulsa (steep), Haewol Observatory. Early night: 07:30 departure tomorrow.

days.title: Busan → Ho Chi Minh City

moves.label: Haeundae → Gimhae Airport (~40 min), leave ~07:30
Grab SGN T2 → District 1 (~30–45 min)

notes: Half 'before' (Korea builder): breakfast + taxi; Korea tax refund at PUS. Half 'after' (Vietnam builder): arrival, District 1 afternoon (Saigon Central Post Office, Notre-Dame area), dinner.
Clocks go back 2 h (KST → ICT).

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City · Cu Chi Tunnels
notes: Suggested: Cu Chi Tunnels half day (1.5–2 h each way; go early), afternoon/evening in District 1 (Bui Vien at night).

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City
notes: Ben Thanh Market (bargain), War Remnants Museum, Independence Palace, street food.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City → Da Nang → Hoi An

sleep.area: near Old Town (walk to the tailors)
sleep.note: The Da Nang block (3 days, Cities tab) is based in Hoi An: tailor fittings + Old Town evenings; Da Nang sights are day trips.

moves.label: Grab District 1 → SGN T3 domestic (~30–40 min), leave ~11:30
DAD → Hoi An by car/Grab (~45 min)

notes: HCMC morning (breakfast pho, last sights).
ORDER THE TAILORING TODAY (day 1 of the block): suit, overcoats, trench coats, ao dai (shopping list) — get 2–3 quotes, see the cloth, expect 2+ fittings.
Sat night: Da Nang Dragon Bridge fire & water show 21:00 (Sat/Sun) — optional tonight or Sun Oct 24.

days.title: Da Nang / Hoi An
notes: Suggested: Ba Na Hills + Golden Bridge (full day, ~1h15 from Hoi An; go early), Dragon Bridge show 21:00 (Sun) on the way back. First tailor fitting in the evening.

days.title: Da Nang / Hoi An
notes: Suggested: My Son Sanctuary early (~1 h) or Marble Mountains + Lady Buddha/Monkey Mountain; Hoi An Old Town sights (Japanese Covered Bridge, Fujian Assembly Hall, Quan Cong Temple) + lantern evening; second fitting.

days.title: Hoi An → Hanoi

sleep.note: Same hotel as Oct 31 – Nov 1; it keeps the big bags during the Ninh Binh + Sa Pa loop (Oct 27–30).

moves.label: Hoi An → DAD (~45 min), leave ~14:30
HAN T1 → Old Quarter (~45 min)

notes: Morning: final fitting + pickup; beach (An Bang) if time. Evening: Old Quarter street-food dinner.

days.title: Hanoi → Ninh Binh

moves.label: Private car Hanoi → Ninh Binh (~2 h), leave ~07:30; daypacks only

notes: Weekday = fewer crowds than weekends. Suggested: Trang An boat (~2.5 h), Hoa Lu, Mua Caves at sunset (500 steps).

days.title: Ninh Binh → Hanoi · night train to Lao Cai

sleep.note: On SP1 Hanoi 21:35 → Lao Cai 05:15 (private sleeper cabin)

moves.label: Private car Ninh Binh → Hanoi (~2 h), ~13:30 → 15:30
SP1 Hanoi Station 21:35 → Lao Cai 05:15 (+1), private 4-berth cabin (book the whole cabin)
moves.bookingWindow: No fixed window; weekend trains sell out — book ~2 months ahead

notes: Morning Tam Coc boat (~07:00, before the heat/crowds) + bike ride; Hanoi evening: Train Street / Old Quarter dinner, then the station (check which of Station A (Le Duan) / B (Tran Quy Cap) the cabin operator uses).
Stay = null (night train). The train leg is fixed-time and crosses midnight: Hanoi Station item (last today) → Lao Cai Station item (first Oct 29).

days.title: Sa Pa

sleep.area: Sa Pa town / Muong Hoa valley view

moves.label: Lao Cai Station → Sa Pa shuttle/car (~1 h)

notes: Arrive 05:15: breakfast in Lao Cai or at the hotel (ask for early check-in), then Cat Cat village / Sa Pa town; Fansipan cable car if clear.

days.title: Sa Pa · night train to Hanoi

moves.label: Sa Pa → Lao Cai Station (~1 h), leave ~19:15
SP2 Lao Cai 20:55 → Hanoi 04:35 (+1), private cabin
moves.bookingWindow: Sat-night train — sells out; book ~2 months ahead

notes: Muong Hoa valley trek (Lao Chai → Ta Van) with a local guide; keep the hotel room or luggage until evening (late check-out).

days.title: Hanoi

sleep.note: Book this stay from the night of Oct 30 (one extra paid night) so the 04:35 arrival can check straight in and sleep.

notes: Arrive 04:35: hotel, sleep until ~10:00. Sun evening: Hoan Kiem walking streets (Fri–Sun) + Beer Street.
Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum: mornings only, closed Mon & Fri, and usually shut for maintenance for part of the year — verify before planning it.

days.title: Hanoi
notes: Temple of Literature, Hoan Kiem Lake, egg coffee, Train Street (access sometimes restricted), street food.

days.title: Hanoi → Taipei

moves.label: Old Quarter → HAN T2 (~45 min), leave ~09:15
Airport MRT express TPE → Taipei Main Station (~38 min)

notes: Half 'before' (Vietnam builder): breakfast + VAT refund at HAN. Half 'after' (Taiwan builder): check-in, night market dinner (e.g. Raohe or Ningxia).
Clocks go forward 1 h (ICT → CST).

days.title: Taipei
notes: National Palace Museum (closed Mon — Wed is fine), Da'an District, Daan Forest Park, Wang Tea, cocktail bars in Da'an.

days.title: Jiufen + Shifen

moves.label: TRA Taipei → Ruifang (~45 min), Pingxi Line Ruifang → Shifen (~25 min)
Shifen → Jiufen by taxi (~30 min); Jiufen → Taipei by bus 965/1062 (~1–1.5 h)

notes: Weekday on purpose (Jiufen Old Street is packed on weekends/midday). Shifen 0.5 + Jiufen 0.5 (Cities tab); Jiufen at dusk for the lantern view, Jiufen Teahouse; Teapot Mountain hike only if starting early.

days.title: Taipei (flex day)
notes: FLEX DAY: the Cities tab totals 31 days; this is the one unallocated day (see flex). Fill with Taipei (e.g. Beitou hot springs, Elephant Mountain, Taipei 101, Longshan Temple) or move it (see allocation.flex.alternatives).

days.title: Taipei → fly home

moves.label: Airport MRT Taipei Main Station → TPE T2 (~38 min), leave ~18:30

notes: Full Taipei day until ~18:00 (late check-out or luggage storage). Taiwan tax refund (TRS) at TPE before check-in.

days.title: Istanbul layover → Newark

moves.label: IST layover 05:10 → 18:50 (Layover item)

notes: Only the flight block's items (Layover at IST + EWR arrival). US clocks go back 1 h at 02:00 on Nov 7.
Optional: Touristanbul free city tour (6–24 h connections) or the TK Business Lounge.

blocks.how: Oct 9 evening, Oct 10–11, Oct 12 early morning
Oct 14 late evening, Oct 15–16, Oct 17 early
Based in Hoi An (Hoi An row has no days: counted inside Da Nang): Oct 23 from ~16:00, Oct 24–25, Oct 26 until ~14:30
Oct 26 evening, Oct 28 evening, Oct 31 (after sleeping in), Nov 1, Nov 2 until ~09:15
Night trains both ways: Oct 29 from 05:15, Oct 30 until ~19:15
Nov 2 from ~17:00, Nov 3, Nov 5 (flex), Nov 6 until ~18:30

totals.asiaDays: Oct 3 – Nov 6 = 35 calendar days; 32 nights in hotels/ryokan, 2 on night trains, 2 on overnight flights (Oct 2, Nov 6), Nov 7 home.

flex.why: Cities tab = 31 days; Oct 3 – Nov 6 gives ~32.5 usable days after travel. The spare day lands in Taipei because TK25 leaves at 21:45 on Nov 6 (Nov 6 is a near-full day).
alternatives: Da Nang/Hoi An +1 night (more tailor-fitting slack, Ba Na Hills and My Son both unhurried): shift Oct 26 – Nov 2 one day later; VN174 and BR398 fly daily.
Hanoi +1 day: fly BR398 on Nov 3 instead of Nov 2.

closuresAndEvents: Sat Oct 9: Ghibli Park open 09:00–17:00 (weekends/holidays; closed Tue).
Mon Oct 11: Sports Day (JP national holiday) — Kyoto crowds; Mon-closed museums open, close Tue Oct 12.
Oct 23/24 (Sat/Sun) 21:00: Da Nang Dragon Bridge fire & water show.
Fri–Sun evenings: Hanoi Hoan Kiem walking streets (Sun Oct 31 in plan).
Taipei: National Palace Museum closed Mondays (no Monday in the Taiwan block).
Nov 7 02:00: US DST ends (EWR arrival in EST).

bookingWindows.what: JR reserved seats (Fuji Excursion, Shinkansen, Haruka)

bookingWindows.rule: 10th of the month two months before, 14:00 Asia/Tokyo
2 months before (new from Oct 2026); time assumed 07:00 Asia/Seoul — verify
no fixed window; book ~2 months ahead (weekend trains sell out)

budgets.note: Per person, whole trip (knives, watch, lenses, pillow, tailoring…).
